allowed_conclusions: Two observed positive-shared-read fusion materializations are rejected during R9 imported-seed facts extraction before scoring.
Both materialized fused kernels preserve indexed stores and verified source work while reducing duplicate indexed loads in the observed examples.
No evidence establishes a performance effect, a native mapper result, or failure of every legal fusion/fission alternative.

cache_and_native.cache_key_evidence: Cost catalog binds source graph identity and exact current task IDs; score key includes candidate/cost bytes, current function IR, task edges and shapes; mapper cache compares complete wrapper/shape/architecture input.

finding.description: R9 sibling and producer-consumer materializers emit complete typed fusion metadata with positive eliminated_loads, while the R9 extractor requires zero eliminated_loads for those modes. Imported required seeds fail facts extraction before prediction/scoring.
finding.scope: Observed mismatch covers both measured fusion paths; it is not shape-specific in the extractor. R9 still accepts sibling/retained cases with zero eliminated loads and correctly formed forwarded 1/1 metadata. The two fission materializations have no fusion metadata.

fission_materializations.implication: These two artifacts do not exercise the fusion-metadata predicate.

materialized_fusion_evidence.rejected_by_r9_because: R9 retained validator requires eliminated_loads == 0 and eliminated_stores == 0
materialized_fusion_evidence.retained_store_semantics: producer write and consumer output write remain yielded; consumer indexed load is shared
